# Hugsy

> Source-owned iOS components and services for iOS 17+ and Swift 6. Every component ships a SwiftUI view and a UIKit view controller adapter.

## Start here

- [Documentation](https://hugsy.pulkit.page/docs/): CLI installation, integration, and MCP configuration.
- [Complete guide](https://hugsy.pulkit.page/llms-full.txt): all component metadata and usage.
- [JSON registry](https://hugsy.pulkit.page/r/index.json): versioned source files and SHA-256 checksums.

## Local tools

Run `hugsy list --json`, `hugsy info <name> --json`, `hugsy init`, and `hugsy add <name> --dry-run --json`.
Run `hugsy mcp` for read-only tools, resources, and an integration prompt over stdio.
Never overwrite customized source without explicit permission. The Swift source has no third-party dependencies.
The default is an editable local Swift package. Add it in Xcode, attach HugsyComponents to the app target, and use import HugsyComponents. Source mode is explicit and requires target membership instead. Installing files does not link the app.

Every page is also available as Markdown. Replace the trailing slash with .md, for example /docs/cli.md or /components/swipe-deck.md. The home page is /index.md.
